invariants.rule: Golden closure requires exactly the ordinary-human, winged-humanoid, aquatic-non-humanoid, centaur-like-quadruped, construct/android, multi-form-shapeshifter, incorporeal and radically-alien fixture classes.
Every fixture is evaluated through the same workflow key set and the same referenced MVPS owner contracts; fixture-specific test branches may not replace the common matrix.

Core creation/runtime/equipment/environment/progression/transformation/persistence/presentation/reuse behavior is selected by typed canonical data and owner references, never species name or identity conditionals.

Equipment conformance succeeds when the common compatibility contract returns governed compatibility/adaptation or an explicit sourced incompatibility; unsupported body plans are never silently coerced.
Species progression and transformation may be absent, but absence must be explicit not_applicable under their existing optional contracts rather than inferred or treated as failure.

Every fixture proves mandatory creation/selection, validation, runtime projection, equipment, environment, serialization/import-export, migration, authoring/inspection/presentation and NPC/Creature reuse surfaces.
Golden proof may consume owner contracts but never transfers canonical mutation or runtime execution authority into MVPS-16.
MVPS program completion is forbidden while the golden matrix has any unresolved semantic gap, guessed owner dependency, species-name dispatch requirement or unproven mandatory workflow.
